description: This file defines the LifecycleManager class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares the class's interface, including methods for initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval, as well as nested Notification class for handling lifecycle state notifications. It also includes external dependencies and interface aggregations relevant to lifecycle management in a plugin architecture.
